concerns.text: The plan computes a ΔAUC/TSS decline on future (2050) climate pixels (step 6‑7) but provides no independent ground‑truth observations for that future period. AUC/TSS require presence‑absence data; using model‑generated suitability scores as both predictor and outcome creates a circular validation where the metric is defined by the model itself, violating independence of validation targets from predictors.
